_meta.source: Wholphin (Jetpack Compose TV). Paths relative to repo root reference/wholphin/. W = app/src/main/java/com/github/damontecres/wholphin/, R = app/src/main/res/
_meta.lightModeNote: WholphinTheme(darkTheme=true) default; every call site passes true (W/MainActivity.kt:266, W/ui/theme/Theme.kt:34). Light values are included only for completeness.
_meta.accentRole: border (TV scheme only) is the focus/accent color
_meta.libDefaultNote: Values flagged libDefault come from androidx.tv:tv-material 1.1.0-alpha01 / compose material3, not the repo; unverified recollection.

m3OutlineVariant.note: compose-material3 darkColorScheme() default outlineVariant: the color of every material3 HorizontalDivider. No theme's darkSchemeMaterial passes outlineVariant, so it is the same in all eight themes.

typography.source: W/ui/theme/Type.kt:5 = androidx.tv.material3 Typography() (library default, no overrides)

fontFamily.text: system default (Roboto on Android TV); no text font bundled
fontFamily.icons: R/font/fa_solid_900.ttf (Font Awesome Solid) declared at W/ui/UiConstants.kt:16

typography.verifiedNote: Letter spacing corrected against androidx tv-material TypographyTokens (see src/ui/LIB_DEFAULTS.md).

motionMs.pageTransition: libDefault androidx.navigation3 NavDisplay (no custom spec in repo)

paletteRules.secondary: vibrant if cool else muted if cool else vibrant else muted

layoutDp.designCanvas: 960x540 dp (Android TV 1080p at 320dpi); NOT enforced in code
